title: Air vs Water on a free Sunday
caption:
Same free Sunday, two completely different plans.

Air has three brunch invites and a maybe-party, and is saying yes to all of them. Water is horizontal and at peace, watching one perfect cup of tea go cold. By 8pm, both are glowing.

The useful bit: Air recharges with people, Water with peace. Neither is wrong.

Tag your Sunday opposite.
